scientific_integrity: Analytic proof includes a constructive radius and explicit Lyapunov increment. Finite exact-rational tests are illustrative, not an infinite proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Local first exit only; perturbations must have triangular scalar-feedback form, with continuous g=o(|y|). The general two-coordinate nonlinear fold conjecture is not resolved. Priority outside searched literature is not certified.
title: A sign-free scalar-feedback escape theorem at nonsmooth folds
